summary: Destructor for loaded mesh data supporting two storage formats selected by flags at this+0x0: bit 0 (0x1) material-block format and bit 1 (0x2) texture/animation-block format. Releases per-block sub-allocations (refcount decrements, 8-byte and 12-byte element destruction) and frees the top-level strided arrays, returning 0 on every path.

operations.description: Format flags at this+0x0: when bit 1 (0x2) is clear the material-block path runs; when bit 0 (0x1) is also clear the function returns 0 with no format selected.
Material-block path: iterate while the block count at this+0xC is greater than 0 (guard:0).
Each material block (sub-allocation pointer read from the array at this+0x10, stride 44, at block+40) has its 32-byte-strided sub-entries released by one RefcountDecrement each.
Free the material block sub-allocation memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Top-level material array (this+0x10): invoke EmptyStub_7470 on each 44-byte-strided element before the array is freed on the shared tail path.
Texture/animation-block path: iterate while the group count at this+0x14 is greater than 0 (guard:1).
Each group (array at this+0x18, stride 12): free its 8-byte frame-pair sub-entries via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then destroy and free the group sub-array of 8-byte entries via sub_550810.
Top-level texture group array (this+0x18): destroy 12-byte (3 dword) structs via ArrayOfStructDestructorWithCountdown, then free the array via FreeWrapper_7bcf on the shared tail path.
Return 0 on every path (early no-format return, null-array returns, and the final free tail).
